pkgmetadata.longdescription: Easy Effects GTK is a community fork of Easy Effects preserving the GTK4 and libadwaita user interface. It provides advanced audio processing for PipeWire applications, including equalization, compression, limiting, convolution and noise reduction, without requiring Qt or KDE Frameworks.
